reference_sql:
SELECT product_id, product_name, category_id, unit_cost_eur
FROM products
WHERE (category_id = 15 OR category_id = 16) AND unit_cost_eur >= 100
alternatives:
SELECT product_id, product_name, category_id, unit_cost_eur
FROM products
WHERE unit_cost_eur >= 100 AND (category_id = 16 OR category_id = 15)

SELECT product_id, product_name, category_id, unit_cost_eur
FROM products
WHERE (category_id = 15 AND unit_cost_eur >= 100) OR (category_id = 16 AND unit_cost_eur >= 100)

SELECT product_id, product_name, category_id, unit_cost_eur
FROM products
WHERE (category_id = 15 OR category_id = 16) AND NOT unit_cost_eur < 100
